summary: DjangoLux 1.16.1 runtime with its own task worker: exchange-rate refresh keeps running on Celery, Excel sales reports write text as text, and the stack files move to schema 5.
highlights: Updated the application framework to DjangoLux 1.16.1; it needs Composer 1.10.1 or newer and the new stack files.
DjangoLux's tasks and backups run in a new worker service; the exchange-rate refresh keeps its own Celery service.
Sales Report to Excel keeps customer names, descriptions and numbers as text, so a value starting with = can never run as a formula.
Stored files stay private: a server still on an older release gets this fix in the same upgrade.
New DLUX_FRONT_PROXY setting names the proxy in front of this server, so login lockout and the activity log record real client addresses.
The database container no longer restarts when the image or stack version changes.
